title: One Less Errand — Cold Soda on Tap at Home
description:
A glass of soda shouldn't take a trip to the store. This animated short follows the routine of hauling cases of cans home, then shows the idea behind the home soda machine I'm developing: cold carbonated water and two flavors waiting under the counter, poured from a faucet in the style and finish you choose.

Explore the design and follow the build:
https://homesodamachine.com

0:00 The routine
0:30 The next glass
0:46 At the faucet
1:03 Choose your style
1:19 Choose your finish

An animated design preview. Narration generated with Google Gemini; original music and sound design.
